facts.title: Lentil Baked Ziti
ingredients: 1 ¼ cups regular brown lentils, picked over for debris and rinsed
12 ounces whole grain ziti, rigatoni or penne pasta
8 ounces (2 packed cups) grated part-skim mozzarella cheese, divided
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
Pinch of red pepper flakes (omit if sensitive to spice)
23.5 ounces Newman’s Own Organics Marinara, divided
1 cup cottage cheese or ricotta cheese**
Handful of torn fresh basil leaves, for garnishing
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
